greedy.description: Always picks 3 highest-EV players available. Simple and locally optimal — never thinks ahead.

major_saver.description: Protects fresh top-15 players for Signature/Major events. Uses mid-tier in Standard weeks, deploys stars in big spots.

balanced.description: Deliberately mixes 1 star + 1 mid + 1 value per week. Diversifies across tiers, avoids early burnout.
